subject: Technical deep dive recap: Latency & throughput SLOs for FinTechCo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechco.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Technical deep dive recap: Latency & throughput SLOs for FinTechCo

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time to run through your production profile today. Quick recap so we’re all aligned and to capture next steps. Let me know if I misunderstood anything.

High-level goals / pain points you shared:
- Customer-facing real-time summarization features must feel <instant> to end users — critical for conversion (current pain: long tail latency causing poor UX).
- Peak concurrency during market open: ~1.2k concurrent generation sessions (bursty, 10x baseline).
- Average request size: 400–800 tokens; occasional long-context jobs up to 8k tokens for retrospective analysis.
- Cost sensitivity: want to keep per-1000-token cost predictable and minimize spend on cold starts.
- Compliance: data residency in us-east required; private VPC option preferred for production.

Model / inference requirements we discussed:
- Need streaming responses and low tail latency (p95 and p99 targets).
- Model family: LLM-3-style family (ca. 30B) or smaller optimized variants for throughput; must support KV cache and quantized execution.
- Tokenization & prompt templates will be standardized — expect 60% of tokens to be prompt/context and 40% generation on average.

Proposed latency & throughput SLOs (initial proposal):
- p95 end-to-end generation latency (first-token): <= 150 ms for 512-token responses on dedicated capacity.
- p99 end-to-end generation latency (first-token): <= 350 ms for 512-token responses; for long-context (>=2k tokens), p99 <= 1.2s for initial token.
- Sustained throughput: support 1.5k concurrent streams with target average per-request token throughput >= 40 tokens/sec per stream under steady state (burst capacity to 3k for 10 minutes).
- Availability target: 99.95% for dedicated clusters serving FinTechCo production.

Deployment topology recommendations:
- Dedicated (reserved) GPU pool in us-east-1 for production. Enables predictable latency, KV cache persistence, and controlled scaling.
- Hosted API for non-sensitive workloads and initial proof-of-concept to test prompt engineering at lower cost.
- Optional private control plane + VPC peering for audit logs, KMS integration, and SOC-friendly network controls.

Open risks & items to validate:
- Network egress and VPC routing — need your networking team to confirm firewall/peering rules.
- Quantization/regression testing: we’ll run an eval harness to ensure quality drop is within your threshold (>=95% parity on key metrics).
- Burst handling: confirm whether 10x burst for 10 minutes aligns with expected market-open behavior (you indicated yes).

Action items / next steps:
1) I’ve attached a short SLO proposal and a network topology diagram (see attachments). Please review and flag anything missing.
2) Schedule follow-up call: propose Wed 3/3 11:00am PT to align on procurement and sizing (I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm).
3) We’ll kick off a 2-week eval on Dedicated with a small reserved pool (engineering-run to validate p99).

Who does what:
- Marissa (me): finalize SLO doc, coordinate eval cluster setup, send estimated cost model.
- Aditya: will draft the procurement path and draft contract terms for Dedicated.
- FinTechCo: provide sample prompt sets and representative traffic shape + network contact for peering.

Thanks — appreciate the detailed session.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: 20270301-fintechco-slo-proposal.pdf, network-topology-diagram.png
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>

Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechco.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive recap: Latency & throughput SLOs for FinTechCo

Thanks Marissa — this is great, and appreciates the clear write-up. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Burst profile: confirmed — market open is the hairy one. We typically see a 9–12x spike for ~8–12 minutes starting at 09:30 ET. So your 10x for 10 minutes is a good starting assumption.

2) p99 targets: the proposed numbers look promising. One note: for long-context retrospective jobs (8k tokens) the user expectation is not as strict; we care more about throughput and cost there. If you can call out separate SLOs for interactive vs batch-retrospective that’d be helpful.

3) Security & compliance: we prefer Dedicated in a customer VPC with KMS integrated. We can share our security questionnaire and a network contact (Carmen Ortiz).

4) Timing: Wed 3/3 11am PT works for us.

One more ask — can you include an estimate of cost delta between the Dedicated config and the hosted inference for our expected traffic shape? A rough ballpark is fine for planning.

Thanks again — cc’ing Priya who will own the security questionnaire on our side.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Product | FinTechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com | +1 (212) 555-9876

- Interactive vs retrospective SLOs: agreed. I updated the attached SLO proposal to separate interactive (strict p95/p99 targets) vs retrospective/batch (throughput & cost-focused). See section 2 of the PDF.
- Security / VPC: we support Dedicated with private control plane and KMS. I’ve cc’d Aditya for procurement next steps and Priyom for engineering setup. Carmen’s network contact will be perfect — can you share their contact and a preliminary firewall/peering requirements doc?
- Cost delta: we’ll produce a ballpark cost comparison ahead of Wednesday’s call. Rough order of magnitude: hosted is typically 20–40% cheaper for low-to-mid utilization, Dedicated becomes more economical at scale (esp. with reserved capacity and batching optimizations). I’ll include sample scenarios in the cost model.

Next steps (updated):
- Marissa: send updated SLO PDF (done), cost scenarios (by Tue EOD), and calendar invite for Wed 3/3 11am PT.
- Aditya: draft procurement path and initial contract term options.
- Priya/FinTechCo: share security questionnaire + Carmen Ortiz network contact.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the invite and the cost sheet.

Best,
Marissa
